author: Camping Campster
text: Austin was fantastic and even let me know well in advance he was running just a little bit behind. The service was fast and Professional. Took only about 30 minutes to get the tank pumped. Highly recommending to all who are looking for Septic Tank Services.

author: Darmita Cox
text: Great Service at a reasonable price! Austin knew precisely where to go in my yard. He only used a shovel to get to the two sides to pump. I'm happy with his professionalism and expertise. Will use again and recommend others to do the same.

author: Jose Rendon
text: They came out and did an excellent job. They are extremely honest people father and son worked so well together I will definitely be using them always.

author: Brandon Allen
text: So Grateful to this company coming out same day right away for my septic emergency. Austin and his Pops were knowledgeable and and explained the process every step up the way. Just purchase our home and the previous owner built a deck over the tank. Wasn't a easy job but they were successful and got my home back functioning in no time. Will be using them for all my continued maintenance and pumping.

author: T G
text: ALK Septic Service did a fantastic job. They are super friendly and no nonsense in getting the job done. I would rehire them in a second.
